meta.name: ultimate-browsing
meta.description: Escalation skill for blocked or hard-to-reach web access — load it when a normal browse/fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare, JS-only render, login-gated, or a platform a generic fetcher cannot read). Tiered router: TIER 1 insane-search (headless extraction + WAF bypass via curl_cffi TLS impersonation, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, public APIs, Playwright real-Chrome fallback); TIER 1.5 agent-reach (platform-native readers for Chinese and social platforms: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, V2EX, WeChat, plus Twitter/Reddit/LinkedIn/GitHub); TIER 2 Chrome stealth (CloakBrowser stealth Chromium + agent-browser CDP for clicks, forms, screenshots, video, cookie login). Triggers: blocked site, bypass bot detection, cloudflare/WAF bypass, scrape, stealth browser, import cookies, fill form, screenshot, play youtube, xiaohongshu, douyin, weibo, bilibili, v2ex, wechat article, podcast transcript. NOT for simple searches (use web-search) or plain fetches (use webfetch).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绕过网页封锁，抓取任何受限内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到网站封锁或需要抓取动态渲染的页面
copy.tagline_en: Bypass web blocks and scrape any restricted content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often encounter blocked websites or need to scrape dynamically rendered pages

howto.what: 遇到被屏蔽或难以访问的网页时，Claude 会改用三层工具：先无头提取内容，再尝试平台专用读取器（如小红书、抖音等），最后用隐形浏览器模拟点击、填表、截图等，直到拿到结果。
howto.when: 当普通浏览或抓取被阻止（如 WAF、403、Cloudflare、需登录等），或需要读取小红书、抖音、微博等平台内容，或要模拟点击、截图、登录等操作时触发；简单搜索和普通抓取不适用。

say.text: 这个链接被 Cloudflare 拦截了，帮我提取全文。
say.note: Claude 会先用无头提取，必要时换用隐形浏览器。

say.text: 帮我抓取这条抖音视频的信息。
say.note: 会调用抖音平台读取器获取数据。

say.text: 请用隐形浏览器打开这个页面并截图。
say.note: 将启动 CloakBrowser 并执行截图。

howto.what_en: When a page is blocked or hard to reach, Claude switches to a three-tier toolkit: headless extraction first, then platform-specific readers (e.g. Xiaohongshu, Douyin), and finally a stealth browser to click, fill forms, screenshot, etc., until the content or interaction is done.
howto.when_en: Triggered when normal fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare, login, etc.), for reading Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo etc., or for clicks, screenshots, logins. Not for simple searches or plain fetches.

say_en.text: This link is blocked by Cloudflare; please extract the full text.
say_en.note: It will try headless extraction first, then fall back to stealth browser.

say_en.text: Please fetch info for this Douyin video.
say_en.note: Calls the Douyin platform reader for data.

say_en.text: Open this page with the stealth browser and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Launches CloakBrowser and performs a screenshot.
